subject: Proposal: Add capacity + price cap request / SOW acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Clara Nguyen <clara@medilume.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary capacity uplift + price cap (proposed redline attached)

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Medilume is ready to move forward but we have one ask before legal signs the Order Form. Our product spike this winter will require roughly a 25% uplift to our committed capacity (expected peak starts 2027-01-01) and we want to request a 12-month price cap on any incremental consumption above committed throughput.

We know this touches the MSA/order form and the SOW. To speed review, I attached a marked redline (Medilume_proposed_redline.docx) and a simple capacity estimate (capacity_estimate_q4.csv). Two additional asks from our side:
- Add explicit acceptance criteria to SOW Exhibit A for latency (p95 < 450ms at 99th percentile traffic) and a throughput verification test plan.
- Start billing for the uplift on the date new capacity is provisioned (we expect Jan 1).

Can Redwood confirm whether a 12-month rate cap is feasible and whether the legal team prefers a standalone amendment or an exhibit addendum? We'd like to finalize by Oct 22 to keep our rollout timeline.

Clara
Procurement Lead, Medilume

Attachments: Medilume_proposed_redline.docx, capacity_estimate_q4.csv

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Clara Nguyen <clara@medilume.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary capacity uplift + price cap (proposed redline attached)

Clara — thanks for the clear ask and the redlines. Appreciate the capacity CSV.

Quick read: we can likely support the 25% uplift from an operations perspective, but there are three items we need to align on before legal signs:
1) Billing model for the uplift (monthly pro-rate vs. one-time top-up charge).
2) Locking a price cap for 12 months — commercial is OK to discuss but we need confirmation on minimums/commitments for that period.
3) SOW acceptance test specifics (who runs verification and the remediation SLA if acceptance fails).

Laura — looping you in for legal redline preference (standalone Amendment vs. Exhibit add). Rishi — can you confirm commercial flexibility on a 12-month cap and whether a minimum commit is required?

Clara — if you can confirm desired billing start date and signatory (procurement or finance), I will ask legal to produce a draft amendment and aim to return a marked-up version in 48–72 business hours. Assuming we get final language, we can route to DocuSign the same day.

Next steps (proposed):
- Medilume confirms billing start date and signatory.
- Redwood legal returns draft amendment for review (target Oct 16).
- Finalize and execute by Oct 22.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: capacity_estimate_q4.csv (from Clara)

From: Clara Nguyen <clara@medilume.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <purchasing@medilume.ai>
Date: 2026-10-14T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary capacity uplift + price cap (proposed redline attached)

On 2026-10-14 10:03 AM, Aditya Rao wrote:
> Clara — thanks for the clear ask and the redlines. Appreciate the capacity CSV.
> 
> Quick read: we can likely support the 25% uplift from an operations perspective, but there are three items we need to align on before legal signs:
> 1) Billing model for the uplift (monthly pro-rate vs. one-time top-up charge).
> 2) Locking a price cap for 12 months — commercial is OK to discuss but we need confirmation on minimums/commitments for that period.
> 3) SOW acceptance test specifics (who runs verification and the remediation SLA if acceptance fails).

Thanks — clarifications below:
- Billing start date: provisioned capacity on 2027-01-01; we expect monthly invoicing pro-rated the first month.
- Price cap: Medilume requests an across-the-board cap on per-token rate for any incremental consumption for 12 months; we are not ready to commit to a long-term increase beyond the 12 months but can discuss a minimum nominal purchase (e.g., $20k/mo) if needed to secure the cap.
- Acceptance testing: Medilume will run verification (we will provide test harness), but Redwood must confirm remediation SLA (we propose 5 business days for a triage/patch response and 30 business days for full remediation).

I attached the marked redline and the capacity CSV again for ease. If Redwood legal can provide a draft amendment by Oct 16, we will turn quickly.

Best,
Clara

Attachments: Medilume_proposed_redline.docx, capacity_estimate_q4.csv

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Clara Nguyen <clara@medilume.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T16:38:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: temporary capacity uplift + price cap (proposed redline attached)

Clara — thanks for the detailed follow-up and for the attachments. Quick summary from Redwood legal/commercial:

1) Form of amendment: we recommend a standalone Amendment to the MSA that references the existing Order Form and adds Exhibit X (Capacity & Acceptance). This keeps the operational acceptance language grouped with the SOW while avoiding multiple edits to the MSA.

2) Price cap: commercial is willing to offer a 12-month incremental rate cap conditioned on a minimum spend of $20k/mo for the 12-month period. Rishi has confirmed this is the preferred structure; he will follow up with an updated rate schedule.

3) Billing start date: we can set billing to begin on provisioning (2027-01-01) with pro-rated first invoice. Please confirm the provisioning date in writing and the signatory for execution (Procurement or CFO).

4) Acceptance & remediation: draft Exhibit X will include the acceptance test plan you proposed and a remediation SLA: initial triage within 5 business days and a remediation plan within 30 business days. If acceptance fails repeatedly, the amendment will include an agreed remediation credit schedule (details to be added in the draft).

Next steps:
- Redwood legal will upload a draft Amendment to the shared Drive link and produce a DocuSign envelope (links below) by Oct 16 EOD.
- Medilume to confirm provisioning date and signatory by Oct 18.
- We aim to have executed amendment by Oct 22 to meet your rollout window.

Drive draft: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cDraftAmendment
DocuSign envelope preview: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/ABCDEF12345

Attaching internal draft: redwood_amendment_draft.pdf (internal working copy).

If that timeline works I will coordinate routing and final commercial language with Rishi.

Laura Bennett
Legal Counsel | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_amendment_draft.pdf
